user.title: Daily Podcast Queue
user.description: Pick the Sonos / media player to play on, and the time each morning to prepare that day's playlist. Preparing never auto-plays — you play it on demand. You'll add podcasts next, from Configure.

data.at: Time to prepare the daily playlist
data.enabled: Prepare a playlist automatically each day

abort.single_instance_allowed: Daily Podcast Queue is already configured.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Integration-wide settings. Manage your podcasts (add, edit, remove, reorder) from the "Daily Podcasts" panel in the sidebar.

data.at: Time to prepare the daily playlist
data.enabled: Prepare a playlist automatically each day
data.intraday_enabled: Also refresh during the day (prepare only, never plays)

build_queue.name: Build and play today's podcast queue
build_queue.description: Fetch each feed, include everything new since the last run (per-podcast catch-up; off = today only), record the playlist, and play it (unless play is off).

play_history.name: Play recorded podcast history
play_history.description: Replay recorded daily playlists (catch-up), in chronological order.

get_queue.name: Get the current queue
get_queue.description: Return now-playing info and the live queue (used by the Overview tab).

skip_to.name: Skip to a queue position
skip_to.description: Jump playback to a 0-based position in the current queue (Sonos).

remove_from_queue.name: Remove an item from the queue
remove_from_queue.description: Remove a single item at a 0-based position from the current queue (Sonos).
